{{Quote|Listen, you must go. It's time for you to leave.''"''<br />''"''But where? Where can we go?''"''<br />''"''Wherever you want&mdash;someplace safe. Take those ships. Make new lives for yourselves&hellip; far away from here.|Jedi Knight Dass Jennir and an enslaved Nosaurian discuss the options of the newly freed Nosaurians and Chubbits on a moon of Telerath|<ref name="DT14" />}}
A '''Nosaurian''' wearing a coat was among several captives kept [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by a gang of [[T'surr (species)|T'surri]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runners on [[Telerath's second moon|one of the moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. When rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Dass Jennir]] infiltrated the slave camp, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] defeated the T'surri slavers and freed their [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], a mixed group of [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] and [[Chubbit]]s, urging them to flee. The Nosaurian wearing the heavy coat asked the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] where they should go. He simply told them to make a new life somewhere far away.<ref name="DT14" />
